text: internal_links.py can justify a Related-reading entry on incidental tokens alone (observed 2026-11-18: '51% Test Traps Your Plant' added with 'topical overlap: november, published'). AGENTS.md rule 12 forbids exactly that. Audit the generated block after every push and delete any entry whose only justification is a date word or a site word; patch published/, the CMS body (REST PATCH) and the Supabase row together.

The frontier rewrite reliably flattens an inline internal link to plain text (observed again 2026-11-18 on the tool link). article_shape hard-fails a body with zero inline internal links, so re-grep the _final.md for '](/ ' before the gate; restoring the link is a two-line patch and never needs a re-review.

A reader front 404s for a few minutes after publish.py while the CMS already reports status publish (observed 2026-11-18: 404 at 12:47, 200 at 12:48, context/sitemap.json entry public:false in between). Verify against the front's own sitemap-0.xml for the slug before treating it as a delivery defect; never re-run publish.py, which re-commissions the header image.

verify.sh fails on four scripts/test_illustration_overlay.py subject-map tests (subject score 0.24 where 0.5-0.6 is asserted) and it fails identically at the previous commit, so it is a pre-existing overlay defect, not a run defect. Do not re-cut thresholds blind to green the build: confirm against an older commit first (git checkout <sha> -- scripts/ && pytest), then report it as pre-existing in the run log.
